theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) → X η = X η') → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N, (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) ∧ (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → ∃ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid N) (u : Fin k → Euclid N), (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x u = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (u i)))))) ∧ X η₁ - X η₀ = X η + X.boundary θ) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ v : Fin 0 → Euclid N, (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) ∧ (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ X η₁ - X η₀ = X η
